questions.question: Which is the only continent where wild polar bears are naturally found?
questions.hint: Wild polar bears inhabit Arctic regions of Canada, Alaska (USA), and Greenland, with some populations extending into parts of Russia and Norway's Svalbard. They are not found in Antarctica.

questions.question: Which living bird has the largest wingspan ever reliably recorded?
questions.hint: The Wandering Albatross can reach wingspans of over 3.5 meters (11.5 feet), allowing it to glide vast distances over the Southern Ocean.

questions.question: Which movie won 11 Academy Awards and tied the all-time record alongside Ben-Hur and The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King?
questions.hint: Titanic (1997) won 11 Oscars, tying the record shared by only three films.

questions.question: Which actor portrayed Indiana Jones?
questions.hint: Harrison Ford first played Indiana Jones in Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981).

questions.question: Which city hosts the headquarters of the World Health Organization (WHO)?
questions.hint: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.

questions.question: Which international organization publishes the World Heritage List?
questions.hint: UNESCO recognizes cultural and natural sites of outstanding universal value.

questions.question: Which civilization invented the concept of Olympic Games?
questions.hint: The first recorded Olympic Games were held in Olympia in 776 BC.

questions.question: Which famous route connected China with Europe for centuries?
questions.hint: The Silk Road linked East and West through trade, culture, and technological exchange.

questions.question: Which country has won the most Olympic gold medals in history?
questions.hint: The United States leads the all-time Olympic gold medal table.

questions.question: In Formula One, what does the checkered flag indicate?
questions.hint: The checkered flag signals that the winner has crossed the finish line and the race has concluded.

questions.question: Which country is both in Europe and Asia?
questions.hint: Turkey spans two continents, separated by the Bosporus Strait.

questions.question: Which is the driest non-polar desert in the world?
questions.hint: The Atacama Desert in Chile is one of the driest places on Earth, with some areas receiving virtually no rainfall.

questions.question: Which scientist proposed the heliocentric model that placed the Sun at the center of the Solar System?
questions.hint: Copernicus' heliocentric model revolutionized astronomy and changed our understanding of the universe.

questions.question: What is the most abundant element in the observable universe?
questions.hint: Hydrogen accounts for roughly 75% of the observable universe's normal matter by mass.

questions.question: Which country is the birthplace of the Renaissance?
questions.hint: The Renaissance began in Florence, Italy, during the 14th century before spreading across Europe.

questions.question: Which famous artist painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel?
questions.hint: Michelangelo painted the iconic ceiling between 1508 and 1512.

questions.question: Which mammal has the largest brain of any animal?
questions.hint: The sperm whale possesses the largest brain ever known, weighing around 7–9 kilograms.

questions.question: Which river flows through the cities of Vienna, Budapest, and Belgrade?
questions.hint: The Danube is Europe's second-longest river and flows through more capital cities than any other river.

questions.question: Which scientist discovered the neutron in 1932?
questions.hint: James Chadwick's discovery of the neutron transformed nuclear physics and earned him the 1935 Nobel Prize in Physics.

questions.question: Which empire was ruled by Cyrus the Great?
questions.hint: Cyrus the Great founded the Achaemenid Persian Empire, one of the largest empires of the ancient world.
